textual.context: Promotional context is indicated by the title and description; the records do not establish whether all listed actions are required to receive the voucher.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised gift voucher and unlimited pizza-related benefit are linked in the description to viewer actions including redeeming, commenting, sharing, and subscribing, which may require later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not provide redemption instructions, eligibility conditions, recipient details, proof of the voucher, or the actual content inside the video.

visual.observation: A screen labeled "Authorizing you on Paytm" displays a phone number and asks the user to "ENTER YOUR 6 CHARACTER OTP" before a visible "VERIFY" button.
visual.context: The screen appears within a payment or app-authorization flow; the sampled frame does not explain who requested the OTP beyond the displayed Paytm authorization label.
visual.potential_relevance: A request to submit an authentication code is linked to authorizing a payment-service account or transaction, making the requested sensitive authentication step conditionally relevant for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the OTP was actually entered, who controlled the flow, or whether any unauthorized access or loss occurred.

visual.observation: A payment confirmation shows ₹39 marked "Sent to Mohd" with a transaction ID, while another sampled screen displays a ₹39 purchase for a Domino's new-user voucher.
visual.context: The voucher screen describes a discounted Domino's offer for Little app new users and shows a "BUY NOW ₹39" button; the payment confirmation names the recipient as Mohd.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised discounted voucher is visibly associated with a ₹39 payment, while the sampled payment confirmation identifies an individual recipient rather than the named merchant; this observable payment-recipient and advertised-benefit relationship is conditionally relevant for review.
visual.limitations: The sparse frames do not establish whether Mohd was an authorized payment intermediary, whether the payment purchased the voucher, or whether the voucher was delivered or redeemed.

visual_context_notes.observation: The displayed voucher includes conditions stating it is for Little app new users only, is applicable on the Domino's website, and expires on 19 Dec 2017.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes an apparently unusually valuable Domino's voucher and instructs viewers to redeem it through the video and comment, share, and subscribe. The demonstrated flow includes entering a phone number, providing a Paytm OTP, and sending ₹39 to obtain a voucher, creating a consequential data and payment request. The supplied material does not establish that the voucher or destination is legitimate, while the promotion claims unlimited pizza loot and a ₹100 voucher for ₹39.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: A purported free or discounted voucher is linked to an external purchase and app flow: the voucher screen shows a Domino's new-user voucher with 'BUY NOW ₹39', while the video title and description promote a gift voucher and redemption. The depicted flow expressly requests an existing Paytm authentication code by showing 'Authorizing you on Paytm', asking for a 6 character OTP, and presenting a VERIFY control.
